name: codex-worker
description: Delegate a code change from Claude Code to an outside Codex CLI worker.

interface.shortDescription: Run Codex CLI workers from Claude Code.
interface.longDescription: Guides a Claude Code session that hands a code change to a Codex CLI run. Covers the sandbox scope, the background run, monitoring, follow-ups, and an independent review. Do not use it when the agent itself runs inside Codex.
defaultPrompt: Delegate this change to a Codex worker.
Run a Codex worker on this branch and review its diff.
